attestations.text: CHA Chi-tso 查繼佐 (T. 三秀, 支三, H. 伊璜, 釣史, 釣玉, 興齋, 東山), Aug. 1, 1601–1676, Mar. 4, scholar, was a native of Hai-ning, Chekiang. In his youth he was sickly and his family was poor. When his father was away from home teaching in other families he studied in a village school.
